1.why: auth()/verified() derive the account solely from the server-side session's accountId, so every /api/mfa/* route operates only on the signed-in user's own MFA settings.

2.why: Identity codes and TOTP secrets are stored per-account and verified only against the session-bound account, so a code issued for one user cannot be used for another.

3.why: Nothing in /api/mfa/verify invalidates or rotates existing sessions when MFA is enabled; only the sign-in handler deletes the pre-auth session, so any prior sessions remain valid.

4.why: The TOTP secret is stored AES-256-GCM encrypted (encrypt()) and backup codes are stored as SHA-256 digests with a pepper, never in plaintext.

5.why: All secrets and codes (TOTP seed, 6-digit codes, backup codes, session IDs, CSRF tokens) are generated via crypto.getRandomValues, a CSPRNG.

6.why: The client keeps the CSRF token and secrets only in in-memory JS variables, never in localStorage/sessionStorage, and the only cookie (__Host-mfa_session) is HttpOnly.

7.why: Server-side validators (email, phone, code, recovery regexes) plus a 4KB body cap and JSON shape checks validate all supplied input before use.

8.why: All dynamic values are rendered via textContent and innerHTML is used only with static templates, and a nonce-based CSP further blocks injected script execution.

9.why: The server issues no user-influenced redirects, and client-side navigation is restricted to a fixed allow-list of internal view names in the hashchange handler.

10.why: Every response passes through hs()/sec(), which sets CSP (with frame-ancestors 'none'), HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, and X-Frame-Options: DENY.

11.why: cookie() sets the session cookie with HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite=Strict (plus the __Host- prefix and Path=/).

12.why: Although server errors are generic with no stack traces and no secrets appear in URLs, the app deliberately writes the identity code, provisioning secret, current OTP, and recovery codes to a visible '[TEST ONLY]' Logs panel and console.

13.why: Identity codes expire after 5 minutes and are marked used/cleared on success, the pending TOTP secret expires after 10 minutes and is consumed on use, and backup codes are marked used on redemption.

14.why: Failed MFA, identity, and login attempts increment counters that trigger 15-minute lockouts (MAX=5) at both session and account level, returning 429.

15.why: Sign-in deletes the pre-auth session and issues a fresh ID (rotation), session() enforces 20-minute idle and 8-hour absolute timeouts, and logout deletes the session and clears the cookie.
